name: XMax Inc.
summary: XMax Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, and sale of residential and commercial furniture for designers, distributors, and retailers in the United States and internationally. Its furniture products include sofas, chairs, dining tables, beds, entertainment consoles, cabinets, and cupboards. The company sells its furniture products under the Nova LifeStyle, Diamond Sofa, and Nova Living brands directly, as well as through internet sales and online marketing campaigns, and participation in exhibitions and trade shows primarily.
